craft_notes: Sthāyin: Awaiting inside surrender (pratīkṣā). End-dash→comma (plotlessness stated softly, hold lands). Rejected: 'shiftless' for 'feckless' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Feckless, what feat can I?' — to him who plots no path at all,
all-helping Force of the Benign: my hold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

reads_against.argmap: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one resolving nothing anywhere. → Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is refuge for the resolveless.
c1_essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.

l2.plain_english: Crying 'incapable, what can I do?' with nowhere a resolve to stand on — Śaṅkara's grace that befriends all is where I hide.
